findings.evidence: Mathlib `LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft_apply`/`LinearMap.funLeft_apply` (Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Equiv/Basic.lean:815,856): `funCongrLeft R M e x = x ∘ e`; `coroot_simpleIndex` (Assembly.lean:256) gives `coroot (simpleIndex i) = Pi.single i 1`.
findings.fix: State the two directions separately: the weight map is `x ↦ x ∘ σ⁻¹` (fundamental weights permuted by σ); Mathlib's coweight slot is its transpose `y ↦ y ∘ σ` (simple coroots permuted by σ⁻¹), the coroots themselves being permuted by σ via `coroot_diagramRootPerm`.
findings.issue: Module docstring claims "On both pinned lattices the automorphism is the permutation of coordinates by σ ... and σ permutes each of those two bases." False on the cocharacter side: `coweightMap = funCongrLeft ℤ ℤ σ` (line 300) is `y ↦ y ∘ σ`, so `Pi.single i 1 ↦ Pi.single (σ⁻¹ i) 1`, i.e. it permutes the simple coroots by σ⁻¹, while `weightMap = funCongrLeft ℤ ℤ σ.symm` permutes the fundamental weights by σ.

findings.evidence: Statements at lines 185-188, 216-218, 313-314, 318-319 and RootDatumAutomorphism.lean:72-82 differ by `.symm`; their docstrings do not.
findings.fix: Name the permutation in each docstring, e.g. "precomposition with σ⁻¹" vs "precomposition with σ (the transpose of the weight map)".
findings.issue: Mutually inverse maps carry identical docstrings, so neither says which permutation it is: line 183-184 (`rationalDiagramAut_coweightEquiv_symm`, `funCongrLeft ℚ ℚ σ.symm`) and line 214-215 (`rationalDiagramAut_coweightMap`, `funCongrLeft ℚ ℚ σ`) both read "is the permutation of the simple-coroot coordinates". Same defect at lines 312/317 (`diagramAut_weightMap` uses `σ.symm`, `diagramAut_coweightMap` uses `σ`, both said to "permute the ... coordinates") and at RootDatumAutomorphism.lean:70-82 (`datumGraphAut_weightMap` uses `diagramPerm.symm`, `datumGraphAut_coweightMap` uses `diagramPerm`, both said to permute "by the diagram permutation of the index").

summary: Module docstrings and declaration docstrings are otherwise accurate and complete, but the weight/coweight direction is documented wrongly: the coweight map permutes the simple-coroot basis by σ⁻¹ (it is the transpose slot), yet the docs say σ permutes both bases and describe mutually inverse maps with identical wording.
